project.name: SuperHumans
project.event: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, Istanbul local event
project.challenge: Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions

ai.disclosure: This project was built with Super Intelligence (AI) tools. Claude by Anthropic (through Claude Code) wrote the code of the website, the desktop app and the model-training scripts, drew the IonScan architecture diagram as LaTeX/TikZ code, and helped with research and with the wording of this page. Humans on Team SuperHumans chose the solution idea and the six modules, made the design decisions and checked the results. There are no AI-generated images or video in the project except those that carry a visible "AI-generated" mark. The health data shown is real, openly published research data; none of it was generated by AI.

datasets.name: NASA BPS Microscopy benchmark (Biological and Physical Sciences), from NASA OSDR study OSD-366 / LSDS-111
datasets.cite: Penninckx et al. 2019, NASA Open Science Data Repository OSD-366, DOI 10.26030/v8w4-rg83; NASA BPS Microscopy benchmark, AWS Open Data registry
datasets.licence: BPS Microscopy: no restrictions on use (AWS Open Data registry). OSD-366: no explicit licence field, NASA science data
datasets.use: 77,177 mouse skin-cell nuclei (iron-ion beam, X-ray or no irradiation, on the ground). IonScan was trained on it; excerpts from 3 mice the model never saw are shipped.

datasets.name: An Echo from the past: open access repository of over 10,000 annotated Doppler audio recordings of venous gas emboli
datasets.cite: Blogg et al. 2026, Diving and Hyperbaric Medicine 56(1):8-12; Zenodo record 16877955, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.16877955
datasets.use: 6,826 recordings of at least 5 s from 310 divers trained and tested BubbleGrade. Six clips ship, modified (one channel, resampled to 16 kHz, neutral names); see public/bubblegrade/LICENSE-DATA.txt.

datasets.name: Pierleoni, Mercuri et al. 2019 Doppler recordings (Data in Brief)
datasets.cite: Pierleoni, Mercuri et al. 2019, Data in Brief, PMC6864345
datasets.use: Evaluation only: 30 modern-probe recordings used for one check, which the model failed. The model was not trained on it. No audio, labels or file names of this dataset ship; at most our own model's scores on it.

datasets.name: RedTell DSE set (red blood cell morphology)
datasets.cite: Sadafi et al. 2023, Frontiers in Physiology 14:1058720; Zenodo 7801430 (Helmholtz Munich / University of Zurich)
datasets.use: About 5,700 expert-graded cells in 152 microscope fields trained and tested both SpikeCount models. The 31 held-out fields and cell thumbnails ship.

datasets.name: ThrombUS+ Ultrasound Dataset #1
datasets.cite: ThrombUS+ Ultrasound Dataset #1, Zenodo 17659415; HEALTHINF 2026 paper, Zenodo 18894312
datasets.use: 2,341 leg-vein compression clips from 594 patients trained and tested VeinSqueeze. Six anonymised clips ship ("Clip A-F").

datasets.name: Jugular vein compression clip, additional file S3 (Wikimedia Commons)
datasets.cite: Gillman L, Blaivas M, Lord J, Al-Kadi A, Kirkpatrick A. Scand J Trauma Resusc Emerg Med 2010;18:39
urls: Wikimedia Commons, additional file S3 of the paper
datasets.use: One real neck-vein squeeze clip, cropped by us, shown as context (not a model input).

datasets.name: SegThy (neck ultrasound with expert outlines)
datasets.cite: Kronke M. et al., PLOS ONE 2022; Hugging Face mirror MedOtter/SegThy
datasets.use: One neck sweep of a healthy volunteer with the expert outline, shown as context (not a model input).

datasets.name: OASIS-1 brain MRI, through the neurite-oasis preprocessed release
datasets.cite: Marcus et al. 2007 (OASIS-1); Hoopes et al. 2021, arXiv:2101.01035 (neurite-oasis)
datasets.licence: OASIS Data Use Terms (cite; no re-identification)
datasets.use: 332 brains trained the brain-map model, 40 tested it. Skull-stripped crops of 3 held-out brains ship (no face, no ids, ages or sexes).

datasets.name: OpenNeuro ds005595: HCP-Aging perivascular-space masks
datasets.cite: Chai et al., OpenNeuro ds005595, DOI 10.18112/openneuro.ds005595.v1.0.0; supported by the National Institute on Aging of the NIH under Award Number U01AG052564
datasets.use: 159 people trained the PVS finder, 20 tested it. Brain-masked slices and 3D meshes of 3 held-out people ship.

datasets.name: OpenNeuro ds000239: repeat T1 scans of 3 healthy adults
datasets.use: 120 repeat scans gave the day-to-day noise of our ventricle reading. Numbers only; no image ships.

datasets.name: Hacettepe University VR-sickness EEG
datasets.cite: Ozkan, Uyan & Celikcan 2023, Displays, DOI 10.1016/j.displa.2023.102415; Uyan & Celikcan 2024, Displays, DOI 10.1016/j.displa.2024.102704
datasets.licence: no licence stated by the dataset authors; cited as they request
datasets.use: EEG of 33 people trained and tested the Garn Meter model. One anonymised 224-second excerpt of a held-out person ships.
